name: ghost-fibers
title: Ghost Fibers
description: An almost-black backdrop with a slow current of tiny lilac fibers twisting through it in soft-focus ribbons. The strands glow at the folds and drift all the time, with a faint answer to the pointer.
use: A dark, low-contrast backdrop behind large type or product shots that need quiet motion.
avoid: It is extremely dark, so it almost disappears on bright displays and in most screenshots.
a11y: The canvas is hidden as decoration, but the wrapper has no role or name and the pointer reaction has no key path. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: respected)
looks: On near-black a wide band of minute lavender dots sweeps diagonally like embroidery on folded cloth, brighter along one curved crest at the top. Ends and edges blur into soft haze and a few loose specks.
behaves: The dotted ribbon keeps flowing and twisting, its folds brightening as they catch the light and dimming as they turn away. Moving the cursor bends the fibers nearby and shifts focus; clicking sends a faint pulse of light along the strand.
customise: Props set glow, line and secondary colours, gradient direction, speed, scale, rotation, layer and thread counts, twist, waves, fiber style, depth of field, bloom, grain and pointer response.
weight: heavy: Instanced fiber beads plus five bloom passes and a composite shader run every frame.
